# Daydream Gallery

> A personal gallery of animated scenes and interactive art.

All scenes were developed with AI. The runtime is browser code, not an AI generation service.

## Experience

Choose from 7 scenes at [Daydream Gallery](https://daydream-gallery.pages.dev/).

Choose an image on the home screen to open a scene. Use the home icon to return or the image-list icon to select another scene. The bottom controls offer a new scene, global play/pause, a music panel and a view without controls.

Music starts with the first scene selection. Direct scene links wait for a scene click/tap. Explicit music pause is preserved across scene changes. Open the music-note panel to control playback. Skip tracks, edit order, shuffle, repeat one song and adjust volume. Playback shuffles six tracks once on entry; that order stays until explicitly edited. Scenes preserve track, volume and order. Music/global pause, home and hidden tabs suspend playback at its current position. The public site uses Journey and the five selected CC0 recordings in the same way.

Space toggles global playback, R creates a new scene, M toggles music playback, and F hides the controls. Esc closes an open panel first, otherwise hides controls. Number keys select scenes in menu order. Controls hide after three idle seconds. Click, tap, Tab or a supported shortcut reveals them; pointer movement alone does not.

In ASCII Bloom, choose a shape and color in the bottom bar, then click or tap the scene. In the scene picker, use arrow keys to move, Enter to select and Esc to close. Scene links support reload and browser Back.

## Available scenes

- [ASCII Bloom](https://daydream-gallery.pages.dev/#ascii-bloom): Choose a shape and color, then click or tap to send a wave through a field of characters.
- [Paper Wings](https://daydream-gallery.pages.dev/#paper-wings): Seventeen butterfly families fly independently over hanji paper.
- [White Sands](https://daydream-gallery.pages.dev/#white-sands): A small tree and one red apple above white dunes, with intermittent wind.
- [Glass Valley](https://daydream-gallery.pages.dev/#glass-valley): Travel through a stained-glass mountain valley. Drag to look around.
- [Quiet Ascent](https://daydream-gallery.pages.dev/#quiet-ascent): A small rocket rises through stars, drifting gas and occasional planets.
- [Stillwater](https://daydream-gallery.pages.dev/#stillwater): Water, plants, fish, clouds and falling leaves move through a quiet pond.
- [Journey](https://daydream-gallery.pages.dev/#journey): An isometric drive through coastal, desert and forest landscapes.

## Source

- [Public source code](https://github.com/simpleusername96/daydream-gallery): Generated reviewed runtime, documentation, notices and licenses.
